full.en: ORGANIC SUPERFOOD MUESLI with goji berry, mulberry, cacao nibs, coconut & chia. Ingredients: OAT flakes* (40%), WHEAT flakes* (WHEAT, BARLEY malt extract) (18%), coconut chips (Cocos nucifera) * (8%), buckwheat * (7%), sunflower seeds * (7%), white mulberry (Morus alba) * (7%), grapes sultanas * (5%), goji berry (Lycium barbarum)* (3%), cocoa nibs (Theobroma cacao) * (2%), chia seed (Salvia hispanica) * (2%). * organic. Contains naturally present sugars. May contain traces: SESAME, PEANUTS, SOY BEAN and NUTS. Storage: Store in a cool and dry place. Neto weight: 320 g. Best before end: see top of the bag. It is recommended not to exceed the dose of 15 g of chia seeds per day!
